🚨 HIRING: AI Engineer | 100% Remote
Location: Remote – PST & CST Hours Only
Client: Healthcare

Employment: W2

Visa: USC, GC, H4 EAD

Recent Healthcare Experience: MUST HAVE

We’re seeking an AI Engineer to build and deploy enterprise AI solutions using LLMs, GenAI, RAG, Azure AI, Python, and agentic frameworks.

🔑 Must Have
• LLM / Generative AI / RAG
• Vector Embeddings & Vector Search
• Prompt & Context Engineering
• Agentic AI / Agent Orchestration
• Azure AI Services / Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI
• Strong Python & REST APIs
• FastAPI, LangChain and/or Semantic Kernel
• AI application development & deployment
• CI/CD, MLOps/LLMOps & observability
• SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Teams or Confluence
• Strong communication & stakeholder management
• Recent Healthcare experience

⭐ Preferred
• Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
• Cloud/AI/ML/Data Engineering certifications
• Responsible AI, Data Governance or Healthcare Informatics experience

🎯 Build AI assistants, automation workflows, RAG solutions and production-ready AI applications while partnering with technology, security, compliance and business teams.

📩 Interested? Send your updated resume at ashish.kumar@sourceinfotech.com and LinkedIn profile.
